title: Interconnection Agreement Tariff Version Conflict at QF Billing
scenario_text:
Conduit Energy is billing a 4.2 MW qualifying facility (QF) operated by High Desert Solar LLC for Q1 2026 energy deliveries. The interconnection agreement (IA) was executed in 2008 under Docket No. 08-R-412 and references Rate Schedule QF-2, which was superseded by Rate Schedule QF-3 in the 2019 general rate case (Docket No. 19-R-087).

**Custom FileMaker — Docket Tracking (Docket 08-R-412)**
Entity: High Desert Solar LLC | Facility: 4.2 MW PV | IA Effective: June 15, 2008
Rate Reference: Schedule QF-2 | Contract Term: 25 years
Notes: 'Standard QF IA template, pre-PURPA reform. See Section 8.3 for rate escalation.'
Linked filings: Original IA (SharePoint), Amendment 1 (2014 — capacity increase from 3.8 MW)

**SharePoint — /regulatory/filings/interconnection/high-desert-solar/IA-2008.pdf**
Section 8.3: 'Energy payments shall be calculated at the avoided cost rate in effect at time of delivery, as published in the applicable Rate Schedule.'
Section 8.5: 'Capacity payments shall be fixed at the rate established at contract execution for the full contract term.'
Section 12.1: 'This Agreement shall be governed by tariff provisions in effect as of the Effective Date, except as specifically noted in Section 8.3.'

**SAP — Rate Calculation Module (current billing run)**
Customer: HIGH-DESERT-SOLAR | Rate Schedule applied: QF-3 | Avoided cost rate: $0.0847/kWh
Capacity rate applied: $12.40/kW-month (current QF-3 rate)
Billing period: Jan-Mar 2026 | Flag: 'Rate schedule override required — legacy IA'

**Teams — #regulatory-affairs (Feb 12, 2026, 3:47 PM)**
@william.reeves: SAP flagged High Desert again. The system defaulted to QF-3 capacity rate but their IA locks capacity at execution rate.
@maria.estrada: What was the 2008 QF-2 capacity rate? I can't find it in the current tariff book.
@william.reeves: $8.15/kW-month. It's in the archived tariff sheets on SharePoint, filed under the 08-R-412 docket.
@maria.estrada: Got it. But wait — they did Amendment 1 in 2014 for the capacity increase. Does that reset the capacity rate for the incremental 0.4 MW?
@william.reeves: Good catch. Let me check the amendment language.
[Thread continues with no further replies]

**Outlook — From: william.reeves@conduit-energy.com, To: maria.estrada@conduit-energy.com (Feb 14, 2026)**
Subject: RE: High Desert capacity rate
> Maria — pulled the 2014 amendment. Section 2(b) states: 'Incremental capacity above 3.8 MW shall be compensated at the capacity rate in effect at the time of amendment execution.' The 2014 QF-2 capacity rate was $9.20/kW-month. So we have a split: 3.8 MW at $8.15 and 0.4 MW at $9.20.
> Energy rate is straightforward — Section 8.3 clearly says current avoided cost at time of delivery, so QF-3's $0.0847/kWh applies to all energy.

**SharePoint — /regulatory/tariff-archive/QF-2-schedule-2008.pdf**
Page last accessed: Feb 12, 2026
Capacity Payment Rate (2008): $8.15/kW-month
Avoided Cost Rate (2008): $0.0612/kWh
[Document footer: 'Superseded by Rate Schedule QF-3, effective January 1, 2020, per Docket 19-R-087']
question: What is the correct billing methodology for High Desert Solar LLC's Q1 2026 capacity payment?

contributor.name: William Reeves
contributor.title: Regulatory Affairs Director
contributor.domain_expertise: PUC tariff filings, rate case management, interconnection agreements, regulatory docket tracking

choices: Flag for manual review and withhold capacity payment pending resolution of the unresolved Teams thread
Apply $8.15/kW-month to 3.8 MW and $9.20/kW-month to 0.4 MW, per the original IA Section 8.5 and 2014 amendment Section 2(b)
Apply QF-3 capacity rate of $12.40/kW-month to all 4.2 MW, as the current tariff supersedes the 2008 agreement
Apply $8.15/kW-month to all 4.2 MW, as Section 12.1 governs all provisions by the tariff at the Effective Date
